text: hey so we need to still get a better approach for deleting pieces from the map editor rather than just recompiling at every change, its too much of a delay and its very annoying honestly
resolution: Deleting/moving a baked piece in the map editor no longer recompiles the map. The cause: LoaderIsoView fired requestSettleBake on any 'gone' baked piece, which ran a 1.2s-debounced 'tools/rjit game bake' (~5s) plus a reload — the felt 'recompiles at every change'. That bake was redundant: the live dirty-erase (req_1891) already collapses baked instance rows and hides baked mesh-prop nodes inside the old footprint with zero bake, the GameState DB already holds the deletion as source of truth, and the live overlay re-derives the erase against the stale baked file every session (reload/restart re-baselines bakedRects then erases again). Durable fold-in still rides the existing dirty-on-buildPieces -> map-switch/revisit rebake, identical to how a placement persists. Removed requestSettleBake entirely (LoaderIsoView prop + index.tsx callback/timer/settleBakeTimer); the gone-piece signal now only gates the erase push. So a delete is now as instant and bake-free as a placement. Verified with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int (bundle + native binary compiled clean).
